desc: Build an adjacency list containing both directions of every constraint, storing edge XOR values.
Traverse every component iteratively, assign relative XOR potentials, and detect contradictions including self-loops, duplicate edges, and disconnected vertices.
For each verified component, choose the common XOR offset independently for each bit by comparing counts of set and unset bits in the potentials.
Apply each component’s offset to produce the minimum-sum assignment.
Implement efficient input parsing and ensure the algorithm runs in \(O((N+M)B)\), with \(B\) covering all relevant bits.
